name: pc_health_guardian
description: Broad local Windows/desktop health diagnosis and conservative repair for resource pressure, process memory growth, storage, networking, Windows system-file integrity, event logs, BIOS/UEFI metadata, Plug-and-Play device faults, signed-driver configuration errors, physical-disk health, and Microsoft Defender protection status. Reports software-verification boundaries instead of claiming it can guarantee detection or repair of every physical, firmware, BIOS, driver, or malware failure.

action.description: Action: diagnose, capabilities, memory_leak, repair, monitor, status, stop. Diagnose collects broad local evidence; capabilities explains verified coverage and hard limits; repair applies only evidence-backed repairs; monitor watches for persistent memory growth.

duration.description: Optional monitoring duration such as 15 seconds, 5 minutes, 24 hours, or 24h 5m.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between low-power monitor samples; default 60.

target.description: Repair target: auto, memory, system_files, disk, network, drivers, driver_scan, pnp, security, malware, defender, bios, firmware, hardware, or a specific application process name/PID.

allow_disruptive.description: Permit process termination, long Windows integrity repair, or an on-demand Defender Quick Scan. Default false.

deep.description: Run expensive DISM/SFC integrity verification during diagnosis. Default false.

sample_seconds.description: Seconds between memory-leak samples; default 15, clamped to 5-120.

samples.description: Number of memory-leak samples; default 3, clamped to 3-8.

security_scan.description: Run an explicit Microsoft Defender Quick Scan during diagnose. This can consume significant CPU/disk resources; default false.
